findings.title: Codex guard checked cli_name only, leaving command='codex' bypass path
findings.body: run_audit() guarded route.cli_name in FORBIDDEN_CLI_NAMES but not route.command. A duck-typed or deserialized route with cli_name='claude-audit' and command='codex' bypassed the guard. Fixed by extending guard to also check route.command == 'codex'. Added test_codex_command_raises_even_with_safe_cli_name.

findings.title: Schema allowed inconsistent state combinations (timed_out=true with non-null exit_code)
findings.body: pal_clink_audit_output.schema.json did not constrain exit_code and error based on timed_out. Added allOf if/then: timed_out=true implies exit_code=null and error=non-empty string; exit_code=null implies error=non-empty string. All 4 schema validation tests pass with tightened constraints.

findings.title: No test for empty prompt
findings.body: Empty string prompt encodes to b'' and passes via stdin. Added test_empty_prompt_passed_as_empty_bytes.

findings.title: Unnecessary forward-reference string in _SubprocessRunFn type alias
findings.body: _SubprocessRunFn = Callable[..., 'subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes]'] used quotes unnecessarily since subprocess is already imported. Removed quotes.
